continuous_formula_scope: Named stationary-support fixtures only; world-relative equals support-relative in COMMON_STATIC_WORLD. Moving or missing reference is INVALID_MEASUREMENT.

metrics.catch_real_contact_retention: Actual destination ATTACHED, same material anchor retained at least .6 elapsed seconds with source FREE; B1/ground contributions retained separately. Mandatory safety gate even if continuous fields quarantined.
metrics.settling_time_s: Time from accepted neutral/brake onset to first start of a full speed norm <= .10 m/s and spin norm <= .20 rad/s interval subsequently confirmed for .25 elapsed seconds.
metrics.stop_path_m: Full 3D COM path from accepted onset through the start of the subsequently confirmed stable interval; not signed drift or onset-target accuracy.
metrics.brake_50_time_s: First actual directed velocity <= 50% of onset directed velocity, only while accepted world intent opposes the onset axis. Onset directed speed must be >= .15 m/s.
metrics.brake_10_time_s: Same directed criterion at 10%; passive later settling cannot satisfy active braking.
metrics.legacy_v131_diagnostics: Nine existing typed metrics, horizons and FULL-NORM brake fractions are retained under their old formula ID only. No silent migration to directed-speed fractions. Useful progress, path, drift, excursion, reversal and settling stay distinct.

identity: Source, engine, scenario, actual fixture mapping, clock, phase, bindings, tape and accepted/effective prefixes required; equal requested tape hash alone is insufficient.
qualification: Final per-capability eligibility is a separately hashed report decision after independent review; this catalog supplies no search authorization.
